description: Routing module for the 'rulechain' feature in an Angular application, defining routes, resolvers, guards, and breadcrumb functions related to rule chains.

classes.name: RuleChainResolver
classes.description: Resolver to fetch a RuleChain by ID.

classes.name: RuleChainMetaDataResolver
classes.description: Resolver to fetch metadata for a RuleChain.

classes.name: RuleNodeComponentsResolver
classes.description: Resolver to fetch RuleNode components based on modules map and rule chain type.

classes.name: TooltipsterResolver
classes.description: Resolver to dynamically import the Tooltipster library.

classes.name: RuleChainImportGuard
classes.description: Guard to check if rule chain import is allowed based on item buffer.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Fetches data via the associated service for each resolver.
